content.title: THE DEFICIENCY SIGNS YOUR BLOOD TEST OFTEN {{MISSES}}
facts: **Potassium** – muscle cramps, irregular heartbeat, constant fatigue, and tingling in your hands or feet.
**Vitamin C** – bleeding gums, bruises that won't fade, slow-healing cuts, and catching every cold going around.
**Omega-3** – dry flaky skin, stiff achy joints, brittle nails, and trouble focusing at work.
**Vitamin B12** – numb fingertips, brain fog, unusually pale skin, and mood dips that seem to come from nowhere.
**Folate** – mouth sores, breathlessness on light activity, irritability, and deep exhaustion that sleep doesn't fix.
**Vitamin A** – night blindness, dry itchy eyes, rough patchy skin, and infections that keep coming back.
**Vitamin E** – muscle weakness, poor coordination, blurred vision, and a pins-and-needles feeling in your limbs.
**Vitamin D** – deep bone aches, low energy that won't lift, thinning hair, and a low mood that lingers.
**Vitamin K** – bruising from the smallest bump, cuts that won't stop weeping, and unexplained heavy bleeding.
**Copper** – pale skin, brittle bones, frequent illness, and hair greying earlier than it should.
**Follow along** – for more daily health tips like this.
content.caption:
Your **potassium** levels quietly control the electrical signals that keep your heart beating steady, so even a small dip can throw your rhythm off and leave your muscles twitchy or weak. **Vitamin C** isn't just an immune helper, it's what your body uses to build collagen, which is why gums, gums, skin, and blood vessels start breaking down first when levels run low. And **omega-3** fats are literally built into the membrane of every cell, so when you're short on them your skin, joints, and even your focus can start to feel 'off' in ways that are easy to blink at first. Everyone's body is different, so treat these as clues worth paying attention to, not a diagnosis.

At @smarthealthfix we dig into nutrition, everyday symptoms, organ function, and the small daily habits that quietly shape how you feel. Our mission is to help you notice what your body is telling you and build small, realistic changes instead of chasing quick fixes.

Save this post so you don't lose it, and share it with someone who's been feeling 'off' lately.
